highlights: Save seed: you can now enter a count at any point — when you save the lot, and at every stage after — instead of only when you mark it stored.
Marking a lot stored now asks for the count. Enter 0 if none of it was viable; the seed no longer goes missing from Sow now because the box was left blank.
A lot you have saved but not started processing shows under 'Still in process — not started yet' on Sow now, instead of being filed as already sown.
'Seed saved' in the event menu now opens the Save seed sheet, so it creates a real lot and still records the event on the plant's timeline.
Editing a saved-seed lot explains itself in plain words instead of showing a database constraint name.
Bigger tap targets on the Saved seeds page.
